Interested in this property? Sign up for mySherryFitz to arrange your viewing, see current offers, or make your own offer. Register now at SherryFitz.ie.

The Willows is a 5-bedroom dormer bungalow set on a large 3.2-acre private plot which has obvious potential for the development of at least one more property subject to the relevant planning permission. There is a rectangular plot to the side of the property which enjoys direct road frontage, which if developed would not take away from the privacy of the house.
The home is situated in one of Wexford Town's most sought-after locations Larkinstown, Coolree, in an address that has always been very popular for those looking for large properties on large sites that are within close proximity to Wexford Town, its schools and all its amenities.
The property is currently laid out to include a one-bedroom self-contained apartment, perfect for a "Granny Flat" or "The Rent a Room Scheme".
The current layout of the property lends itself to many options depending on your needs, for instance:
The integrated garage could be incorporated into the house (subject to p.p.) to increase the size of the downstairs living area.
There is plenty of scope for an office or two or three for those working remotely.
There is certainly room to run a business from the property, especially with the close proximity to town.
For those looking for a large family home, there is a ready to go template for flexible family living.
If its outside space you are looking for, you have 3.2 acres to play around with, the mature garden comes with the benefit of a large workshop and huge storage unit (room for the camper van!).
"The Willows" is truly a great family property.
